parsed_json.up: Select the first 500 activity measurements for monoamine oxidase B (CHEMBL221), ranked by potency. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays and target_dictionary to filter by target CHEMBL221. Include compound structures via an INNER JOIN to compound_structures. Return chembl_id, canonical_smiles, standard_type, standard_value, and standard_units. Sort by potency (standard_value ascending) and limit to 500 rows.
